idi.title: Binding Software | R&D
idi.heading: BIT: fast and secure document verification
paragraphs: “BIT” is Binding Software’s innovative document verification technology for reading, authenticating and validating identity documents in under 20 seconds.
It natively integrates Electronic ID, MiDNI and official documents from any country, applying secure extraction and structural data validation automatically.

This technology unifies multi-sector reading, origin validation and delivery of reliable data to the hotel PMS in a single system, ensuring maximum accuracy, reduced operating times and a radically smoother check-in experience.

riskTexts.manual: Manual: Manual data entry by an employee.
riskTexts.ocr: OCR: automatic character recognition to capture data.
riskTexts.scanner: Scanner: capture the physical document with a scanning device.
riskTexts.digital: Digital reading: data extracted directly from an electronic document.
riskTexts.visual: Visual check: manual verification of the documents by an employee.
riskTexts.tech: Technological check: automatic identity validation with Binding.
riskTexts.paper: All on paper: full management of documents in physical format.
riskTexts.tablet: Tablet and paper: mixed process with digital and paper elements.
riskTexts.electronic: Fully electronic: digital management of documents and signatures.
riskTexts.illegal: I violate the law: you are not applying clear data protection measures.
riskTexts.unknown: I don’t know if I comply: your process has no clear compliance guarantee.
riskTexts.certified: Legal certificate: your process complies with current data protection laws.

summary.safe: Your check-in process is well optimized and safe.

summary.vulnerable: Your configuration needs adjustments to become more secure.
summary.danger: Your check-in process has significant security risks.
